title: Berry_Forest
lead_summary:
Berry Forest is at the end of the Bond Bridge.
The first time the player enters, Jasmine will request some help to find her nephew and his friends. After finding them all and defeating the imposter Zoroark, she will accept to duel the player on the Bond Bridge.
